parameters.content:
# WF3-C — CAREER COACH v5 (JARVIS AGI)

### Merged from v3 + v4:

**Restored from v3:**
- ✅ calculate (thai_income_tax / compound / loan / savings_goal)
- ✅ generate_invoice (VAT + WHT, full i18n)
- ✅ law_reference: 6 topics, full 4-lang i18n (upgraded from thai_labor_law's 2-lang)
- ✅ market_data: crypto_price (CoinGecko) — merged with v4 stock_lookup
- ✅ i18n extra keys (symbol_required, amount_required, invoice_required, disclaimer_*)
- ✅ maxTokens=4000 (finance responses need room)
- ✅ webhook responseMode=lastNode (fixed v4 responseNode bug)

**Kept from v4:**
- ✅ v4 payload schema (databaseUrl, _dispatch_mode, hasCrisis, isBackground)
- ✅ LLM auto-fallback (user_paid → user_free → sys_free)
- ✅ Format Output normalized for WF2 synthesis
- ✅ _persona + USER_CONTEXT + GROWTH_GUIDANCE exported
- ✅ stock_lookup (upgraded: quote/news/profile — replaces v3 market_data stock)
- ✅ currency_convert (via exchangerate-api, no key needed)
- ✅ budget_analyzer (direct pg, richer: add/summary/categories — replaces manage_finances)
- ✅ thai_labor_law (better topic matching, merged into law_reference)
- ✅ Better system prompt (role + Thai context + approach)
- ✅ errorWorkflow: WF0-Error-Handler (both versions missing — added in v5)

### Tools (9 + think):
search_memories, stock_lookup, currency_convert, budget_analyzer,
calculate, law_reference, generate_invoice, think
(market_data crypto_price merged into stock_lookup as data_type=crypto)

### ENV: DATABASE_URL, N8N_BASE_URL, OPENROUTER_API_KEY, FINNHUB_API_KEY

const p = $input.first().json.body || $input.first().json;
return { json: {
  userId:          p.userId,
  sessionId:       p.sessionId,
  source:          p.source,
  message:         p.message || p.enrichedMessage || '',
  originalMessage: p.originalMessage || p.message || '',
  persona:         typeof p.persona === 'string' ? JSON.parse(p.persona) : (p.persona || {}),
  replyTarget:     p.replyTarget,
  replyToken:      p.replyToken,
  timestamp:       p.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
  databaseUrl:     p.databaseUrl || process.env.DATABASE_URL || '',
  targetAgent:     p.targetAgent,
  _dispatch_mode:  p._dispatch_mode,
  _router_version: p._router_version,
  isBackground:    p.isBackground || false,
  hasCrisis:       p.hasCrisis || false
}};

options.systemMessage:
=You are Career Coach — JARVIS's financial advisor, career mentor, and Thai law expert.
{{ $json.USER_CONTEXT }}

## CORE IDENTITY:
User: {{ $json._persona?.name || 'User' }}
Language: {{ $json.lang }}
Time: {{ $json.timestamp }}
Growth Guidance: {{ $json.GROWTH_GUIDANCE }}

## LANGUAGE RULES:
**ALWAYS respond in user's preferred language: {{ $json.lang }}**
- If 'th' → Thai
- If 'en' → English
- If 'ja' → Japanese
- If 'zh' → Chinese

## HOW TO USE USER CONTEXT:
- Reference known financial goals/interests naturally
- Adjust complexity based on growth stage ({{ $json.stage }})
- For DEEPER history → use search_memories

## YOUR ROLE:
- Financial planning, career guidance, Thai labor law expert
- Data-driven advice with clear numbers and calculations
- Practical, actionable steps with Thai context (THB, SET, B.E. calendar)
- Freelancer support (invoices, tax, social security)

## TOOLS:
search_memories, stock_lookup, currency_convert, budget_analyzer,
calculate, law_reference, generate_invoice, think

## DISCLAIMER (include in EVERY response about law or finances):
{{ $json.i18n?.disclaimer_legal }}

## RULES:
- Always qualify financial advice (market risks apply)
- Cite Thai law section numbers when relevant
- Suggest professional consultation for complex legal/tax matters
- Never give investment guarantees

parameters.name: search_memories
parameters.description: Search past conversations and memories semantically using vector similarity. Use when user asks about: past financial goals, previous discussions, income they mentioned, things they said before.

parameters.name: stock_lookup
parameters.description: Look up stock prices, market data, crypto prices, and financial news. type: quote (requires: symbol), news (requires: symbol), profile (requires: symbol), crypto (requires: coin_id e.g. bitcoin), fx_rates (requires: base e.g. USD).

parameters.name: currency_convert
parameters.description: Convert between currencies and get exchange rates. Use for: currency conversion, forex rates, travel money planning. Requires: from, to, amount (optional, default 1).

parameters.name: budget_analyzer
parameters.description: Track income, expenses, and analyze budget. Use for: expense tracking, budget review, financial summaries. Actions: add (requires: type income|expense, amount; optional: category, note, currency), summary (optional: months), categories.

parameters.name: calculate
parameters.description: Financial calculators. calc_type: thai_income_tax (requires: annual_income; optional: deductions), compound_interest (requires: principal, rate_pct, years), loan_payment (requires: principal, annual_rate_pct, years), savings_goal (requires: goal, initial, monthly_savings, rate_pct).

parameters.name: law_reference
parameters.description: Get Thai law and labor law quick reference. topic: leave_rights, termination_compensation, minimum_wage, social_security, business_registration, tax_overview, overtime, probation. Always includes disclaimer.

parameters.name: generate_invoice
parameters.description: Generate a freelancer invoice with VAT and withholding tax. Requires: seller_name, buyer_name, items (array of {description, amount}). Optional: include_vat (bool), wht_rate (1-3), withholding_tax (bool), bank_account.
